# sherpa-container-footer

The footer bar for a container's `footer` slot.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Container Footer |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-container-footer/sherpa-container-footer.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-container-footer/sherpa-container-footer.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-container-footer/sherpa-container-footer.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-container-footer/sherpa-container-footer.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-container-footer/sherpa-container-footer.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-container-footer><sherpa-button>Cancel</sherpa-button><sherpa-button data-look="saturated">Save</sherpa-button></sherpa-container-footer>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-align` | `between` `end` `start` `stretch` | `end` | start \| end \| between \| stretch At "stretch" ONE wide control fills the row (a chat composer, a search field), rather than buttons clustered at one end. |
| `data-dirty` | `true` `false` |  | true \| false — the HOST says whether anything has changed. False turns its pair off: the controls marked data-footer="commit" and data-footer="revert". Absent, the footer leaves them alone. TRAP T-the-footer-owns-nothing-to-save |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | control, input | footer action controls (reflects has-content-slot) |
